cohort: Infants under 6 months of age, with a case group of 62 infants with APN and a control group of 178 healthy infants
finding: Feeding exclusively with formula before 6 months of age was associated with a higher risk for APN, indicating a protective effect of breastfeeding, while other risk factors included birth order (≥ 2nd-born), low birth weight, and birth via cesarean section.
mod_finding: Birth via cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of APN.
